label: Diagram 11.1
caption: Diagram 11.1 Renovation of a thermal element from the outside
description: The drawing is a front elevation of a two-storey house with a pitched roof. The wall is shown in plain green, with four windows laid out in two rows of two. The lower-left quarter of the wall, which includes one window, is filled with diagonal hatching. To the right of the house a legend gives two keys: a hatched square paired with the words "Area of the thermal element being renovated", and a plain green square paired with the words "Total area of the thermal element". Above the house a line of running text reads: "For example, if external render is being removed from the outer side of a wall, the area of the thermal element is the area of the elevation in which that wall sits." A green band along the bottom edge carries the caption "Diagram 11.1 Renovation of a thermal element from the outside". The hatched region thus marks a portion of the green elevation that the legend identifies as the part being renovated.
